name: Parking Space Management and Revenue Statistics

map.按车场总车位、包月占用与临停数据，算出临停周转率、日均在场车辆数、车位占用率与月: From the total number of spaces, monthly occupancy and transient parking data, compute the transient turnover rate, average daily vehicles on site, space occupancy rate and monthly revenue mix, for the property monthly report and income disclosure. Average vehicles on site is estimated from "transient parking sessions × average parking duration ÷ 24". Data is processed locally in the browser only and never uploaded.
map.📖 查看「停车（位管理/收费）统计 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Parking (Space Management / Fees) Statistics" guide
map.临停位周转率 = 当日临停车次 ÷ 临停车位: Transient space turnover = transient sessions that day ÷ transient spaces
map.预计月收入 = 临停车次 × 时长 × 单价 × 30 + 包月车位 × 月租: Estimated monthly revenue = transient sessions × duration × unit price × 30 + monthly spaces × monthly rent
map.按车场总车位、包月占用与临停数据，算出临停周转率、日均在拥车辆数、车位占用率与月: From the total number of spaces, monthly occupancy and transient parking data, compute the transient turnover rate, average daily vehicles on site, space occupancy rate and monthly revenue mix, for the property monthly report and income disclosure. Average vehicles on site is estimated from "transient parking sessions × average parking duration ÷ 24". All data is processed locally in the browser and never uploaded.
map.📚 深度解析：停车（位管理/收费）统计: 📚 Deep dive: parking (space management / fees) statistics
map.物业按月统计车位利用率、临停收入与欠费: Property management reviews space utilisation, transient income and arrears monthly
map.核对道闸系统与收费台账，防跑冒滴漏: Reconcile the barrier system against the fee ledger to catch leakage
map.业主大会公示车位收支，论证涨价或开放共享: Disclose parking income and expenses at the homeowners' meeting to justify a price rise or shared spaces
map.固定车位 200 个（出租 180、空置 20）、临停月收入 4.5 万元、欠费: 200 fixed spaces (180 rented, 20 vacant), transient monthly income 45000 CNY, arrears 8000 CNY → utilisation 90%, transient share 33%, arrears rate 1.5%.
map.道闸记录临停 1500 次但台账 1380 次 → 差 120 次，排查免费放行: The barrier records 1500 transient sessions but the ledger shows 1380 → a gap of 120; check free releases and manual barrier lifts, and closing the gap could recover about 3600 CNY/month.
map.出租固定位除以总固定位，结合临停周转；长期空置位应调价或转共享。: Rented fixed spaces divided by total fixed spaces, combined with transient turnover; long-vacant spaces should be repriced or converted to shared use.
map.收费和系统对不上先查什么？: What to check first when fees and the system disagree?
map.先查免费放行权限、手动抬杆记录与包月到期未续，这三处最易漏收。: Start with free-release permissions, manual barrier lift records and monthly passes that expired without renewal, since these three leak fees most often.
